name: subagents
description: Model-tiered Claude Code subagents: haiku for mechanical execution, sonnet for well-specified development, opus for open-ended development and read-only review

interface.shortDescription: Four model-tiered Claude Code subagents to delegate work by cost and judgment required
interface.longDescription: Claude Code subagent definitions loaded from the bundle's agents/ directory: haiku-task runs simple, explicitly scoped mechanical work at low cost; sonnet-dev implements well-specified changes where the parent already decided what to change; opus-highlevel-dev handles open-ended work where the agent must find the cause or choose the approach; opus-review is a read-only reviewer for bug hunting, plan review, and verifying other agents' output. Each agent returns conclusions and validation results rather than a step-by-step log. The bundle ships no skills; other harnesses load it as an empty plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use haiku-task to apply this rename across the listed files.
Have sonnet-dev implement step 3 of the plan and report the test results.
Have opus-highlevel-dev find the root cause of this flaky test and fix it.
